items: **The Business.** Amprius is a real silicon-anode producer with aviation-led traction — record **$34.03M** quarters at **27%** gross margin, a **$24.0M** drone order, a **>$100M** Stark opportunity from 2027, and SiCore500 on conventional kit — scaling asset-light through Korean partners with DIU backing. It is a pre-profit scale-up, not a franchise.

**The Economics.** The sole determinant of long-term per-share value is **forward ROIC vs the cost of capital**, driven by terminal margin and WACC — not revenue headlines. History (**−9.45%** ROIC, **−53.5%** FCF margin) destroys value; the Base assumes a thin +1.5pp forward spread (15% vs 13.5%) that is plausible but entirely unproven.

**The Market's Expectations.** At **$9.61** the market prices **~$1.0–1.5B** of mature revenue at **~20–25%** EBIT margins — the Bull-to-Extreme path (35% combined probability) treated as the median. Aggressive verging on heroic; the unanimous-analyst **$23** target (+139%) is the sentiment anchor for that pricing.

**The Valuation.** Consensus base intrinsic value **~$2.52/share**; probability-weighted **~$4.26/share**; bear **~$0.46–1.00**; bull **~$6.87** with an extreme tail **~$14.15**. Damodaran workbook: **$0.46** / **$0.93** / **$2.36** / **$5.85** / **$14.15**, weighted **$3.93**. Confidence: **Low/Medium**. Expected upside ≈ **−56%**, 5-year annualized ≈ **−15.0%**.

**The Investment Decision.** **D — AVOID / DO NOT INITIATE** at **$9.61** (do-not-initiate band **$9.75** and above). Only small (1–3%) speculative capital stages **$7.50–$9.75** with Q3 confirmation; fundamental capital begins accumulating at **$2.00–$4.00**, with high conviction below **$2.00** — provided the monitoring hierarchy (rates/margins > ROIC > FCF-per-share > order conversion > dilution) stays intact.
conclusions.title: The Five Consensus Conclusions

agreements: **The inflection is real.** Record **$34.03M** Q2 (+126% YoY) at **27%** gross margin, TTM **$109.23M**, FY26 guide raised twice (**≥$140M** / **≥28%** / adj. EBITDA **≥+$4M**) — revenue and margin momentum are facts, not narrative.

**No current owner earnings to buy.** Owner earnings **~−$60M**, FCF **−$58.44M** TTM, OCF **−$52.87M**, ROE **−36.07%**, ROIC **−9.45%**. The investment is entirely a wager on future per-share cash flow.
**The moat is narrow at best.** Emerging silicon-anode/qualification edge; no scale, cost, network, or pricing-power moat against CATL/Panasonic/Samsung SDI. Nobody grants wide or even moderate.

**Dilution is the per-share tax.** Shares **116.93M → 146.08M** in eighteen months (+17.2% YoY), **~22M** of warrant/option/RSU overhang (~15%), SBC **~$8.3M** guide. Enterprise value can grow while per-share value stalls.

**Double concentration fragility.** Two customers **~54%** of AR (**$40.65M**) with Ukraine/EMEA weight, stacked on Berzelius + Korea contract-manufacturer dependence plus tariff/China-control exposure.
**Solvent, not strong.** Cash **$74.52M** vs debt **$6.38M** (net cash **$68.14M**); current ratio 7.17. No near-term distress — but roughly a year of runway absent inflection or financing.
**$9.61 embeds successful execution.** **~12.9x** sales and **~11.1x** book on negative earnings; every intrinsic-value model sits below the price; margin of safety is absent to negative.

**One valuation-critical variable: forward ROIC vs the cost of capital (via terminal margin and WACC).** WACC and terminal margin move value 2–3x more than revenue headlines; all five lenses reduce to the same hinge.
contentions: **Reference price: one price, two objects.** Buffett/Munger/Damodaran frame scenario values as **intrinsic value today**; Druckenmiller (**$7.00**/**$11.00**/**$18.00**) and Soros (**$6.00**/**$13.50**/**$23.00**) frame theirs as **12-month price expectations**. Both concede their cells are price paths, not IV. **Resolved:** the three IV models set the consensus IV; Druckenmiller/Soros inform the ladder and triggers.

**Where does base-case intrinsic value sit?** Munger **$1.58** (strictest, 20.05% discount), Damodaran **$2.36** (verified workbook), Buffett **$3.63** (neutral ramp, friendly 11% discount). Buffett concedes his base assumes competent execution; Munger concedes 20.05% is deliberately punitive and **$2.36** is the defensible center. **Resolved:** consensus base ≈ **~$2.52** (mean of the three).

**How much credit for the right tail?** Buffett heroic bull **~$12.39** (flawless, no further dilution — conceded fragile); Munger caps at **$2.36**; Damodaran Bull **$5.85** / Extreme **$14.15** at 35% combined (conceded generous); Druckenmiller **$18.00–$26.00** and Soros **$23.00–$32.00** are squeeze-inclusive price paths, not value. **Resolved:** consensus bull **~$6.87**, extreme tail **~$14.15** — watch the story, never pay for it at **$9.61**.

**What price compensates for the uncertainty?** Munger **≤$1.10** / Buffett **≤$2.35–$3.30** / Damodaran **$2.00–$4.00** for investment capital vs Druckenmiller **$7.50–$9.50** tranches / Soros **$7.75–$9.75** staged speculation (1–3%, hard-stopped). Druckenmiller concedes his zone has no IV margin of safety; Soros concedes **$9.61** sits at the extreme top of his band. **Resolved:** composite ladder — nothing full-sized above **$9.75**; speculation only on weakness; accumulation at **$2.00–$4.00**.

**Management: 5/10 operators vs adequate allocators.** Candid disclosure, two guide raises, correct CM pivot — against the Brighton reversal, 17%-a-year dilution, 2.19% insider ownership, never-earned cost of capital. Buffett concedes disclosure quality is genuinely good; Damodaran concedes execution positives. **Resolved:** consensus **5/10** — candid operators, unproven allocators.

**Is positive 12-month price expectancy a reason to buy?** Druckenmiller **+27%** and Soros **+49–53%** (to **~$14.30**) are tail-driven (10–20% weights on +87–233% outcomes) with uninsurable left tails; both concede expectancy without timing is not a position. **Resolved:** positive expectancy justifies **monitoring with staged, stop-defined speculative capital only** — and is why nobody rates E/Short.

exec_summary.lead: Amprius is a genuinely inflecting silicon-anode battery business — record **$34.03M** quarters at **27%** margins, a raised **≥$140M** guide, marquee drone/defense wins — priced as if the scale-up has already succeeded. Five independent analyses each refused full-sized exposure at **$9.61** and converged on the **same rating: D — AVOID / DO NOT INITIATE**. The technology is not in dispute; the per-share economics (dilution, concentration, unproven ROIC flip) and the **~12.9x**-sales price are.

judgment.paragraph: At a price of **$9.61**, the market is effectively paying for Amprius to execute its Bull-to-Extreme scale-up — roughly **$1.0–1.5B** of mature revenue at **~20–25%** EBIT margins with smooth contract-manufacturing yields, on-time SiCore500 qualification, Stark converting in full, and no further per-share dilution — with essentially no penalty for concentration, qualification risk, or the Stage 4 tape. Five independent frameworks — owner-earnings value, multidisciplinary quality, fundamental DCF, macro/liquidity-driven expectations, and reflexivity — all refuse investment-sized exposure at this price, all land on a **D (Avoid / Do not initiate)**, and all place the valuation-critical variable on the same hinge: whether forward ROIC exceeds the **~13.5%** cost of capital. We agree the technology is genuinely impressive, the revenue/margin inflection is factual, dilution-plus-concentration is the certain left friction, and **$9.61** compensates neither. The most dangerous risks are a dilutive raise into weakness cementing the negative loop, an anchor-customer or SiCore500 qualification failure, CM/yield or China-supply disruption, and terminal margins compressing toward commodity levels. Therefore, at today's price the consensus is to **wait**: allow only staged 1–3% speculation on weakness inside **$7.50–$9.75** with Q3 confirmation, accumulate investment capital at **$2.00–$4.00**, demand high-conviction pricing below **$2.00**, and let demonstrated return on capital — not drone headlines or the **$23** analyst target — decide whether this impressive technology becomes a good investment.

No wide moat, ROE **−36.07%**, owner earnings **~−$60M**, shares **116.93M → 146.08M**. Interest only at **≤$2.35–$3.30**. "Operational momentum is real; value-investment qualification is not."

Earnings direction 8/10 vs Fed hike to 3.75–4.00%, 10Y near 5%, price −29% below long averages. **C — Monitor**; tranches only **$7.50–$9.50**, 1–2% max.

profiles.paragraph: Reflexive-turnaround speculation: depressed perception (dilutive-SPAC pricing, **15.85%** short) vs inflected reality (**$34.03M**, **27%** margins, concentration 52%→25%). Scenario prices: bear **$6.00**, base **$13.50**, bull **$23.00**, weighted **~$14.30** (+49–53%, ~4.9x asymmetry) — but fallibility HIGH. **B — speculative scale-in $7.75–$9.75**, 1–3%, confirmation-gated.

weighted.text: At **$9.61** that is roughly **−56% expected upside** and **≈ −15.0% 5-year annualized** — **a negative expected return with no margin of safety**. The consensus weighted value converges within ~8% of Damodaran's workbook **$3.93**, making the SBC-aware, 13.5%-WACC, five-scenario framework the defensible anchor. Downside tail (severe bear): −95% from **$9.61**; upside tail (extreme bull): +47%. Confidence: **Low/Medium**. The reverse-DCF check (uncontested): the **$9.61** price implies an EV ~4–5x Damodaran's base case — it requires **~$1.0–1.5B** mature revenue at **~20–25%** EBIT margins: **the market is paying for the Bull-to-Extreme path as the median — aggressive verging on heroic, and no bargain.**
